sources.twistDescription: Verbatim light-register copy. White page background (#ffffff), deep navy headings (#0a2540), crisp blue accent (#2563eb) replacing stripe violet. Status colors added for data tooling context.

Dashboard data font pairing. Inter as primary neutral grotesque (Google Fonts, web-accessible). JetBrains Mono for data labels, stats, numbers. h1 functional scale 2.5-3.25rem w700. Body compact 0.9375rem lh1.5. Data label mono uppercase 0.75rem 0.06em tracking. Stat metric mono 2.5-3.5rem w700.

Minimal functional motion. All durations 100-200ms max. Easing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) only. No spring physics. Scroll reveals: opacity + y:8px. Data counters: count-up on viewport entry. Page load: no entrance animation. Chart draw: 800ms scaleY exception.

Dense data grid with card containers. Container 1440px 24px padding. Main 12-col 16px gutters. Dashboard card grid 24px gap. Sidebar 240px fixed + 1fr. Stats row auto-fill minmax(200px, 1fr). Feature split 3fr 2fr.
Dense compact spacing. All values scaled DOWN by 0.75 vs editorial. Card padding 20px. Section gap 48px. Nav height 56px. Table row 44px. Maximizes data density.

Functional hover states with subtle fills. Button hover darkens 8%. Row hover rgba(0,0,0,0.04). Card hover border-color to accent. Active: rgba fill 12%. Focus: 2px solid accent 2px offset. Transition 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1).
Compact top bar. Height 56px. Fixed top. White background with 1px bottom border. Logo left, links center-grouped, CTA right. Inter 0.875rem w500, no uppercase. Active link: accent-colored text.

Reframed as dashboard data visualization UI. Information density, card-based layout, data hierarchy, monospace numerics. Precision tooling argument. Motion: functional not expressive, 100-200ms except count-up (1200ms) and chart draw (800ms).
